title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Answering Words

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin wins the spring Tenno Sho, snatching victory from the clutches of the prestigious competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But while she celebrates her win, Mejiro Ryan faces her fans and, even after her loss, makes a rousing declaration that reinvigorates both them and herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines watches closely. Sensing that Mejiro Ryan is on another level from her, she begins to seriously consider the way she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In part to determine whether she has what it takes to reach Ryan's level, Ines decides to throw herself into training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
